about_the_game:
Burn the Square with the Solaris! Led by the diabolical, extradimensional Ralmi, the Solaris are here to both defeat their icy foes, the Gaami, and set the Square ablaze! Using the powers of lava, fire, and steam, the Solaris are the biggest challenge the Polytopians have faced, yet!

Features:

  • Transform water and land into solidified volcanic rock with the powers of the Pyro

  • Blast your foes from afar with the Steam Fortress, or get up close and personal with the Steam Wagon

  • Ride the bright pink Tuagamas into battle and use Igmina Crystals to power your hellish powers

  • Harness the powers of volcanoes with well-placed Turbines

  • Reap the rewards of your diligent, Square-wide conflagration with the Lava Bank

  • Use your new tools to wipe out the Gaami, your eternal enemy

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This DLC adds the purely cosmetic "Solaris" skin for the Polaris tribe, which is sold separately.

This DLC cannot be used without purchasing the Polaris tribe first.
